hangzhou-3.bio: Rebuilt five-storey pagoda on Sunset Hill by West Lake, with the original's remains below and lake views from the top.
hangzhou-3.ticket_note: Official ticket site cited by English Wikipedia; not reachable from scripts, check in a real browser. Not confirmed it names the place.
hangzhou-3.notes: Price 40 CNY from Wikipedia citing the official site (2014 cite); not re-verified on operator page.

fuchun-taoyuan.bio: Scenic area near Fuyang with a cave, lakes and forested hills, reached by escalator up the slope.
fuchun-taoyuan.ticket_note: No official site found; www.fuchuntaoyuan.com is a guess and did not load.
fuchun-taoyuan.notes: Price is a 2020 reseller figure; Qunar showed a 140 CNY bundle with extras. Verify. Located in Xukou town, Fuyang.

huzhou-1.bio: Free city museum in Huzhou's Renhuangshan district covering the region's history, art and relics.
huzhou-1.ticket_note: No official site found; may be WeChat only.
sources: https://chinatripedia.com/?p=30548 (ticket free, opened 2006 in Renhuangshan, national second-level museum)
huzhou-1.notes: Free per chinatripedia and Ctrip only; whether a booking/ID is needed is unverified.

guyan-painting-village.bio: Riverside village near Lishui where a historic weir meets painters' studios and bamboo boat rides.
sources: https://gs.ctrip.com/html5/you/sight/lishui441/56153.html (list 50, from 45; ticket covers weir, village and ferry per one travel note)
guyan-painting-village.notes: Weak Ctrip price; village reportedly free to wander early and late, the ticket is for the ferry and weir side. In Datougang town, Liandu.

xikou-1.bio: Chiang Kai-shek's family home in Xikou, the Fenghao Room, among old streets beside the Shan Stream.
xikou-1.notes: 120 CNY seen via search summaries of Qunar/Ctrip; combined tickets with Xuedou Mountain are 205. Stream name 'Shan Stream' (剡溪) from search summary; verify.

guoqing-temple.bio: Sui-dynasty Buddhist temple on Mount Tiantai, birthplace of the Tiantai school, free to enter.
guoqing-temple.notes: Free admission per Ctrip posts and a 2021 Paper report, not an official page. Tiantai school claim from general knowledge/zh wiki; wiki field null because article title matches name.

hangzhou-10.bio: Pedestrian street of restored old shopfronts and snack stalls at the foot of Wushan, home to Hu Qingyu Tang.
hangzhou-10.ticket_note: Open street with no single steward; no official site.
hangzhou-10.notes: Free: open pedestrian street (Ctrip lists it open all day; no admission). Hu Qingyu Tang pharmacy on the street per web search result, not fetched. Street length disagrees between sources (460 m vs 1,800 m); not used.

hangzhou-30.bio: Lakeside park with a red fish pond, peony garden and lawns beside Su Causeway on West Lake.
hangzhou-30.ticket_note: Part of West Lake scenic area; no separate official site found.
hangzhou-30.notes: Free per a guide and by absence from the West Lake paid-park list in search results; no current official page confirmed (price_source_weak). 'Beside Su Causeway' from search snippet (park at its south end, west side). Verify gate policy.

huzhou-3.bio: Museum on Huzhou brush making, the writing brushes the city has made for over two thousand years.
huzhou-3.notes: CONFLICT: Zhejiang Dept of Culture and Tourism page (2019, seen in search result; fetch failed) says free; dahepiao ticket site (2025) says adult CNY 18 with free for under-18s, students, 70+. Recorded free per the government page; if 18 is right use costMin/Max 18. Phone 0572-2503478 to confirm. 'Over two thousand years' of brush making from news search snippet (Shanlian), unfetched; bio claim unverified.

longquan-2.bio: Forest reserve with Zhejiang's highest peak and metasequoia trees in the Fengyangshan range.
longquan-2.ticket_note: No official site found; national park management body not located.
longquan-2.notes: Price from Qunar listing (adult 64; 75 with in-park shuttle) for Baishanzu scenic area at Baishanzu town, Qingyuan; not official, may be dated. Pin is in the reserve near Baishanzu peak. Metasequoia from the draft only, unverified. Wikipedia 'Baishanzu' redirects to the reserve article so wiki is null. Highest peak Huangmaojian is within the reserve (Wikipedia).

xikou-3.bio: Zen temple on Xuedou Mountain above Xikou, tied to the monk Budai and rebuilt several times.
xikou-3.ticket_note: Official Xuedou Mountain site not found via search; no domain guessed.
xikou-3.notes: Ctrip lists Xuedou Mountain from CNY 150 (scenic ticket, reportedly with shuttle); a blog gave 90 for the temple alone, undated. Temple has no confirmed separate gate price; may be covered by the scenic ticket. Budai/Maitreya link and rebuilds from zh Wikipedia (first built Jin dynasty). Free to over-70s; half price 60-70.

shenxianju.bio: Rhyolite peaks and cliffs around Guanyin Peak, with a glass-floored platform and a cable car.
shenxianju.notes: Official site loaded, titled 神仙居景区官方网站. Gate CNY 110 (official). Cable car 65 up / 55 down, Nantianding platform 99 are extras, not the price. 5A scenic area, 22.32 km2 core. The platform (南天顶) is an extra with its own ticket. Wikipedia 'Xianju National Park' is the larger park, not the spot, so wiki null.

hangzhou-20.bio: Limestone hill beside Lingyin Temple, carved with over 300 Buddhist rock statues from the 10th to 14th centuries.
hangzhou-20.ticket_note: Part of the Lingyin Feilai Peak scenic area; only the temple's own site (https://www.lingyinsi.org/) was found and it does not name Feilai Peak, so not used. Reservation is via the scenic area's mini-program (unverified).
hangzhou-20.notes: Scenic area dropped its 45 CNY ticket (and 30 CNY Lingyin Temple incense ticket) from 1 Dec 2025 with real-name timed reservation and daily cap, per news reports; current rules after Nov 2026 unverified. Carving count (300+) and dating from memory/unverified: bio claim needs check against Wikipedia Lingyin Temple 'Feilai Feng grottos' section.

hangzhou-7.bio: Stone bridge on West Lake's north shore, a snow-view spot and the setting of the White Snake legend.
hangzhou-7.ticket_note: Open public bridge on West Lake, no single steward.
hangzhou-7.notes: Free open access is unverified by a fetched source (West Lake's lakeshore is free); legend link from draft only. No Wikipedia article of its own (title is a disambiguation page).

nanbei-lake.bio: Lake-and-hill scenic area near Haiyan with a lakeside road, Butterfly Island tower and views over Hangzhou Bay.
nanbei-lake.ticket_note: Old official site www.nbh.com.cn (linked from zh Wikipedia) no longer loads; no live official site found.
nanbei-lake.notes: Ctrip (weak) lists the area as free entry, all year; some sub-sights charge (Butterfly Island 10 CNY, vehicle entry 20 CNY per a review). An older Qunar entry gave 80 CNY gate: conflicting, verify. 'Views over Hangzhou Bay' and 'Butterfly Island tower' partly from reviews/draft: check. Zh Wikipedia: AAAA scenic area in Haiyan.

ningbo-4.bio: Chan Buddhist temple in the Taibai hills of Yinzhou, one of China's five great Chan temples and the Soto school's cradle.
ningbo-4.ticket_note: No official website found; entry reservation is via the temple's WeChat mini-program per a Ctrip review.
ningbo-4.notes: Free entry per Ctrip (weak), reservation by mini-program reported in a travelogue: verify. Do not confuse with Tiantong National Forest Park, which has its own ticket (about 15 CNY on a group-buy site).

shaoxing-1.bio: Restored old-town quarter around Lu Xun's childhood home, with his memorial hall, the Three Flavours Study and Xianheng Tavern.
shaoxing-1.ticket_note: Reservation is by WeChat official accounts (Shaoxing Culture and Tourism Group / Shaoxing Lu Xun Memorial); no website found.
shaoxing-1.notes: Free but advance booking required per Ctrip and a 2023 notice (weak); sights named in bio (Three Flavours Study, Xianheng Tavern) are from memory, check against a source. Wikipedia article title is 'Lu Xun Native Place' = name.

houtouwan-village.bio: Abandoned fishing village on Shengshan island, its stone houses now buried in ivy, reached on foot down a hillside path.
houtouwan-village.notes: 25 CNY village-entry ticket (10 CNY for the viewing platform only) comes from travelogues only; Ctrip shows no price: unverified, may be dated. Wikipedia describes the village as abandoned, depopulated by 2002, overgrown. Wikipedia article exists as 'Houtouwan'.

hangzhou-21.bio: Buddhist temple at the foot of Nanping Hill on West Lake, a counterpart to Lingyin Temple
hangzhou-21.notes: Price 10 CNY (includes incense sticks) from local-guide/Qunar pages, not official; temple-card holders enter free. No official site found. Verify.

hangzhou-8.bio: Island in West Lake with three stone pagodas standing in the water, reached by boat
hangzhou-8.notes: Price is the West Lake boat plus island ticket (55 CNY standard boat, 70 CNY deluxe) from third-party ticket sites, not official; sources disagree (one lists 79 deluxe). Verify. Wikipedia article not found. Sold via West Lake boat operators, so no single official link.
hangzhou-8.ticket_note: Boat/island ticket sold by West Lake boat operators; no single official site verified

xitang.bio: Canal town of nine rivers and old stone bridges, with lanes of old houses to walk along the water
xitang.notes: Gate ticket 95 CNY (online from about 85) per Ctrip/third-party, includes about 12 small sights; not official. No official site found.

ningbo-5.bio: Buddhist temple in Ningbo's Yinzhou District, open to visitors without an entry fee
ningbo-5.notes: Free entry per Ctrip page and visitor reviews, not an official source. Vegetarian meal is separate (about 10 CNY reported). No official site found.

shaoxing-10.bio: Former family home of Zhou Enlai in Shaoxing, with a small exhibition on his life
shaoxing-10.notes: Free per Tuniu listing and reviews (one 2016 review mentions 18 CNY); not official, verify. No official site found.

jihu-beach.bio: Sandy beach on Sijiao island in the Shengsi Islands, with surfing and jet skis
jihu-beach.notes: Gate ticket 40 CNY from third-party ticket sites and a travelogue (about 2021-22), not official; verify. No official site found. Island is in Shengsi (Zhoushan).

hangzhou-22.bio: A low hill above West Lake's east shore with temples, the Chenghuang Pavilion tower and views over Hangzhou.
hangzhou-22.costPer: Chenghuang Pavilion only; the rest of the hill is free
hangzhou-22.ticket_note: no official site found; hill is run by the city, tower fee reported by news/Ctrip only
hangzhou-22.notes: Only the Chenghuang Pavilion is ticketed (30 CNY per a May 2026 news report seen via search); other areas free. Tower was closed for renovation in 2024-25: reopening unverified. Consider free/open if the hill itself is the spot.

anji-1.bio: Bamboo-covered hills at Tianhuangping near Anji, a film location for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
anji-1.ticket_note: no official site found; ticket office phone 0572-5210999 only
anji-1.notes: 58 CNY is from a 2022 travel post (original price), unverified; discounted 50 from ticket reseller. Film-location claim comes from the draft, not re-verified. Not the Yixing bamboo sea in Jiangsu.

dapan-mountain.bio: Forested peak and nature reserve in Pan'an, central Zhejiang, with hiking trails and herb-rich slopes.
dapan-mountain.ticket_note: no official site found; the reserve's own site link on Wikipedia is dead
dapan-mountain.notes: Peak is 1245 m in Dapanshan National Nature Reserve. Free entry comes from the draft only; no source found, so unverified. 'herb-rich slopes' is unverified: rewrite the bio if not confirmed. Do not use English Wikipedia title (none exists).

ningbo-6.bio: A restored 19th-century Fujianese merchants' guildhall and Mazu temple in Ningbo, now a maritime and folk-art museum.
ningbo-6.ticket_note: museum has no verified official site (old site only in an archived Wikipedia link)
ningbo-6.notes: 10 CNY adult from Chinese Wikipedia (ticket section, 2009 museum page archived); may have changed. Sources disagree on whether Monday is closed: no hours recorded.

shaoxing-3.bio: A garden of ponds, pavilions and a winding stream where Wang Xizhi wrote the Orchid Pavilion Preface in 353.
shaoxing-3.ticket_note: official site not found; only Ctrip/Qunar/resellers
shaoxing-3.notes: Price 70 (reseller 2025) vs 80 (Qunar review): conflicting, weak. Combined ticket with Shen Garden, East Lake, Yu Mausoleum from 145 CNY. No English Wikipedia article for the pavilion.

lulan-qingsha.bio: A 3.6 km curve of fine sand on Daishan Island's east coast, with a paid beach park and water sports.
lulan-qingsha.notes: 30 CNY from one Ctrip review; 3.6 km length from draft; 'water sports' from a 2026 news snippet about upgrades. All weak/unverified; scenic area was being upgraded in 2026.

hangzhou-24.bio: A free canal museum in Gongshu district tracing the Grand Canal's history, beside the canal itself.
hangzhou-24.ticket_note: Reservations run through the museum's WeChat official account; no official website found
hangzhou-24.notes: Free but timed reservation via WeChat (1000 slots/day per 2023 report; may have changed). Not on English Wikipedia.

anji-2.bio: A large bamboo-themed park in Anji with bamboo gardens and the China Bamboo Museum, a county centrepiece.
anji-2.ticket_note: No official site found; not verified
anji-2.notes: 70 CNY adult from an old travel blog; Ctrip shows 70 as lowest listing; current gate price unverified. Museum name from draft, unverified.

jinhua-1.bio: A 5A scenic area north of Jinhua where visitors lie in a small boat to pass through the narrow cave mouth.
jinhua-1.notes: Ctrip lists 80 CNY from (门市价); caves and shuttle may cost extra, unverified. Wikipedia title equals name only for the cave; kept as wiki.

ningbo-8.bio: A rebuilt multi-storey pagoda beside Ningbo's City God Temple that visitors can climb for views over the old centre.
ningbo-8.notes: 5 CNY to climb (cash only, from reviews; seniors and students half). Not climbing is free. Pagoda age and rebuild facts unverified.

shaoxing-4.bio: The memorial site of Yu the Great, legendary flood tamer, with a tomb, temple and stele hall at the foot of Mount Kuaiji.
shaoxing-4.ticket_note: No official site found; Zhejiang tourism page lists it as Kuaiji Mountain Scenic Area
shaoxing-4.notes: 50 CNY from provincial culture and tourism page dated 2019 (surfaced in search; page itself failed to load for me), may have changed. Bio details (tomb, temple, stele) from general knowledge, unverified.

mount-putuo-2.bio: A 33 m bronze Guanyin statue on a stone plaza at the south end of Mount Putuo island, facing the sea.
mount-putuo-2.ticket_note: Island operated through the Putuoshan WeChat account; no official site verified
mount-putuo-2.notes: 6 CNY entry to the statue per travel guides. The island gate fee (160 CNY Feb-Nov) is not counted here. Statue height from draft, unverified.

hangzhou-25.bio: Hangzhou's largest surviving stone arch bridge, a three-arch span marking the end of the Grand Canal
hangzhou-25.ticket_note: Open public bridge on the Grand Canal with no single operator; no official site
hangzhou-25.notes: Free: Ctrip lists the bridge as free to visit (weak source); built 1631, rebuilt 1885, 92.1 m long per zh Wikipedia. Canal boats nearby are separate and not counted.

anji-3.bio: Reservoir resort at Tianhuangping with a lakeside walk, a small tourist train and hill views
anji-3.ticket_note: No official site found; only a ticket phone line (0572-5041858) on Ctrip
anji-3.notes: 80 CNY adult gate price from a Ctrip visitor post and listing (weak, unverified with operator); ski, hot spring and water-park are extra; children 1.2-1.5 m half price. The lake is the upper reservoir of the Tianhuangping pumped-storage plant (zh Wikipedia).

jinhua-4.bio: Taiping prince's mansion in Jinhua's old city, a museum with painted murals and exhibits on the rebellion
jinhua-4.ticket_note: Site is run by the local museum with no official site found; WeChat reservation only per Ctrip review
jinhua-4.notes: Free entry with WeChat QR reservation per a Ctrip review (weak, unverified). Address Gulou Li 70, Wucheng. Draft said 4A/Ming-style: not confirmed.

ningbo-9.bio: Song-dynasty timber hall of 1013 on Lingshan hill, now a museum of ancient Chinese wooden architecture
ningbo-9.ticket_note: No official site found by search
ningbo-9.notes: 18 CNY is Ctrip's lowest listed price, not an operator price; the government page for the Tianyige/Baoguo museum group shows 30 CNY general admission (govt.chinadaily.com.cn, 2021), so the real adult price is unverified. Wiki title taken from the disambiguation page; article existence not fetched. Hall completed 1013, museum since 2006 (zh Wikipedia).

shaoxing-9.bio: Birthplace of the educator Cai Yuanpei, a traditional courtyard house in Shaoxing's old streets
shaoxing-9.ticket_note: Government-owned heritage house; no official site found
shaoxing-9.notes: Free entry is unverified: no source found stating the price; it is not part of the Shaoxing combined ticket mentioned in a Ctrip post. Confirm before applying. Address Bifeinong 13.

mount-putuo-3.bio: Stone Temple, one of Mount Putuo's three major temples, with a grand hall rebuilt in 1699
mount-putuo-3.ticket_note: Reached through the Mount Putuo scenic area; its official booking is a WeChat mini-program, no site found
mount-putuo-3.notes: Price is the Mount Putuo gate ticket (160 Feb-Nov, 140 Dec-Jan) from a 2026 news article (weak); temples themselves reportedly free from 2026, older guides say 5 CNY. Boat (60) and cable car (70) not counted. Check whether other mount-putuo spots use the same gate price. Nine-Dragon ceiling in draft not verified.

hangzhou-27.bio: A nationally protected Jiangnan mansion and garden in Hangzhou's Qinghefang historic district, built in the 1870s.
hangzhou-27.ticket_note: No official site found; official WeChat account only reported by aggregators
hangzhou-27.notes: 20 CNY adult from a ticket-agent page (weak); evening ticket 98 CNY is a separate product. Built date 1872 from draft, unverified beyond that.

anji-4.bio: Waterfall gorge scenic area in Anji's Tianhuangping with a cableway, walking trails and seasonal rafting.
anji-4.notes: 60 CNY from Ctrip only (weak); rafting and cableway cost extra and are not included. 'Tianhuangping town' per Ctrip.

xianhua-mountain.bio: A 4A-rated scenic area of peaks and hiking trails in the hills just north of Pujiang's county seat.
xianhua-mountain.notes: Ctrip sources conflict (35 vs 60 CNY); range recorded, weak. Rated AAAA, 2 km north of Pujiang county seat. No cableway per a Ctrip Q&A.

qiantong-ancient-town.bio: Ancient village near Ninghai with Ming and Qing-era lanes, houses and ancestral halls to wander.
qiantong-ancient-town.notes: Prices 50-70 CNY vary by aggregator (weak). Ming-Qing era is from general knowledge, unverified here; Tong clan ancestral hall reported temporarily closed on Ctrip. Consider softening bio if unverified.

xishi-guli.bio: Open riverside scenic area in Zhuji honouring the beauty Xi Shi, with a shrine, memorial halls and gardens.
xishi-guli.notes: Area itself free per Ctrip (weak); Xishi Hall, Fan Li shrine and other halls charge separately (Xishi Hall about 45 CNY from a user review, unverified). 'Riverside' is unverified; address Zhuluo East Rd.

mount-putuo-6.bio: Mount Putuo's only formal swimming beach, a sand beach on the island's east beside its hotels.
mount-putuo-6.ticket_note: No official site found; Putuoshan Yimatong WeChat mini-program reported
mount-putuo-6.notes: No separate beach fee found: price is Mount Putuo's island gate ticket (160 peak / 120 off-season / 180 holidays per a 2026 article; another gives 140 off-season); ferry excluded. Timed reservation reported. Weak sources.

hangzhou-29.bio: Walled Jiangnan private garden beside West Lake on Yanggong Causeway, with ponds, pavilions and lake views.
hangzhou-29.ticket_note: no official site verified; operator is WeChat/ticket-phone only in search results
hangzhou-29.notes: 10 CNY from an undated Bendibao list and a 2017 Hangzhou news report; current price unverified. Bio details (ponds, pavilions) are generic and unverified beyond the draft: re-check.

anji-8.bio: Memorial hall in Changshuo Park, Anji, to the painter and calligrapher Wu Changshuo, who was born in the county.
anji-8.notes: UNRESOLVED: price/free and current visitor access not confirmed (search gave an old address, Tianmu Rd 572, and no fee). Recommend owner review or drop; cost left unverified.

yiwu-international-trade-city.bio: Giant wholesale market of small commodities in Yiwu, with five districts of stalls selling millions of products.
yiwu-international-trade-city.ticket_note: operator site not verified; yiwugo.com is a B2B platform, not used
yiwu-international-trade-city.notes: Free admission per Zhejiang culture and tourism dept page (2019, old). Draft claim 'every day of the year' not verified, dropped.

xiangshan-global-studios.bio: Film and television studio in Xinqiao, Xiangshan, with period-set streets and backlots used in Chinese productions.
xiangshan-global-studios.ticket_note: official site not found; no Wikipedia official link retrieved
xiangshan-global-studios.notes: 150 CNY list price from Ctrip only (weak). 'period-set streets' bio detail is generic, verify. 4A rated, 784,000 m2, opened 2005 per Wikipedia.

fangshan-geopark.bio: Volcanic plateau scenic area in Wenling with cliffs, the Nansong rock and Shifeng sections, east of Taizhou.
fangshan-geopark.notes: Located in Wenling, Changyu town; Ctrip says Fangshan, Nansongyan and Shifeng sub-areas. Price ~40 CNY from reseller and a 2021 review (weak). Claim that it is part of a global geopark (Yandangshan) is a user comment: unverified, bio avoids it; consider renaming 'Global Geopark'.

nansha-beach.bio: Mountain-backed sand beach on Zhujiajian island, Zhoushan, with roped swimming areas in summer.
nansha-beach.ticket_note: official site not found; operator uses WeChat reservation per search
nansha-beach.notes: Paid scenic area, 70 CNY adult (reseller + Ctrip, weak); a 2026 article cites ~75 and timed reservations, unverified. Reservation may be needed (needs not set).

hangzhou-11.bio: A seven-storey brick-and-wood pagoda above the Qiantang River, climbed for views of the river and its bridge.
hangzhou-11.ticket_note: No official site found; run by the West Lake scenic area's Qianjiang office (Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area); WeChat account only known
hangzhou-11.notes: 10 CNY tower ticket is from a 2011 Hangzhou news report quoting the scenic area office (stale); a Ctrip travel note mentions 20 CNY park entry plus 10 CNY tower. Current price unverified. Wikipedia EN has no article. Crowd-control may suspend tower entry (2025 report).

hangzhou-31.bio: A Y-shaped stream valley in the hills west of West Lake, known for its misty trees and a walk beside the brook.
hangzhou-31.ticket_note: Open scenic valley with no single operator
hangzhou-31.notes: Free per Ctrip page (open all day, weak) and visitor reviews; one 2022 ticket-agent page showing a price is a bundled product, ignored. Ctrip lists open year-round.

huzhou-6.bio: A silk-trade canal town of bridges and Ming-Qing merchant houses, free to stroll, with a few mansions charging entry.
huzhou-6.ticket_note: No official site found; Ctrip listings only
huzhou-6.notes: Old town free from a recent year per a Ctrip travel note (weak). Individual houses charge, e.g. Little Lotus Villa 25 CNY, Zhang Shiming residence 20 CNY (Ctrip, weak); not the spot's cost. Wiki article 'Nanxun' covers the town.

baishuichong-waterfall.bio: A 53 m waterfall near Liangnong in Yuyao, reached on foot from a free car park below Baishui Mountain.
baishuichong-waterfall.ticket_note: No operator or official site known
baishuichong-waterfall.notes: Location (Liangnong town, Yuyao, not Fenghua), 53 m drop and no ticket are from Ctrip travel notes and a search summary only (weak); the Ctrip sight page loaded was a different Ningbo waterfall, so verify. Semi-neglected site.

changshan-geopark.bio: A geopark of limestone landscapes around Changshan's Golden Spike, a global reference point for a geological boundary.
changshan-geopark.notes: 60 CNY comes from a 2019 provincial culture and tourism department page (search summary; page unreachable by script). Park became a UNESCO Global Geopark in April 2026 (Xinhua, per search summary) so price may have changed; Ctrip says ask the scenic area. Unverified.

taizhou-1.bio: A city museum on Aihua Road in Jiaojiang with galleries on Taizhou's history and its folk culture.
taizhou-1.notes: Free (Ctrip 'free admission'; local report says no booking needed, from a holiday notice, may be dated). Site loaded with title 台州博物馆 (only the title was visible to the fetcher).

hangzhou-14.bio: Chipperfield-designed museum of Liangzhu culture, with jade cong and bi from a 5,000-year-old walled city.
hangzhou-14.notes: Free: 2019 Hangzhou news says museum ticket is free; official site loaded (title 良渚博物院) and carries a visit-reservation mini-program notice, hence needs booking. Free status not restated on a current official page; verify. English article title 'Liangzhu Museum' equals name so wiki null. 5,000-year claim is the Liangzhu culture's standard dating, not quoted from a fetched page.

hangzhou-32.bio: Hillside botanical garden on the north-west shore of West Lake, with about 3,400 plant species and a plum-blossom garden.
hangzhou-32.ticket_note: No official site confirmed: hzbg.com.cn returned 403 (BLOCKED) and could not be tied to the garden; hzbg.cn unreachable. Check in a real browser; not recorded as ticketUrl_blocked because domain is a guess.
hangzhou-32.notes: Adult 10 CNY (half-price concession 5) from a third-party ticket site via search and Ctrip concession list; weak, unverified on operator page. Wikipedia: 3,458 plant species, 248 ha, Taoyuanling NW of West Lake; plum 'Lingfeng tan mei' garden from Ctrip. Ticket office hours not recorded. Pass-list check irrelevant (China).

huzhou-7.bio: Private library built 1920-24 in Nanxun, once holding 160,000 volumes, with moated gardens beside Xiaolianzhuang.
huzhou-7.ticket_note: No official site found; Nanxun old town is free and the paid gardens are sold through aggregators.
huzhou-7.notes: Price is a Ctrip 'from 25 CNY' listing for Xiaolianzhuang and Jiaye Tang; a travel note mentions a ~75 CNY combined ticket for several Nanxun gardens. Which one covers Jiaye Tang alone is unverified. Category set to historic (Wikipedia: national key heritage site, library building and gardens) rather than museum; museum also acceptable. No English Wikipedia article (404).

hemudu-site-museum.bio: Museum on the Yao River at the 7,000-year-old Hemudu site, with early rice and the remains of wooden stilt houses.
hemudu-site-museum.ticket_note: hemudusite.com (cited by zh Wikipedia) unreachable from scripts; official site not confirmed.
hemudu-site-museum.notes: Free: zh Wikipedia says free since 2008; Ctrip page marks free (a reviewer says no booking). A new Hemudu archaeological site park began trial operation Feb 2026 with a separate ticket (Ctrip from 28 CNY); whether the museum charges now is unverified. Site 5000-3000 BC dating from zh Wikipedia. No English article (404).

jiangshan-1.bio: Three sandstone peaks in a river-shaped line above Jiangshan, part of China Danxia World Heritage; Langfeng is 816.8 m.
jiangshan-1.ticket_note: No official site found; scenic-area ticket office phone 0570-4911010 on Ctrip.
jiangshan-1.notes: Adult 105 CNY list price (Ctrip, search summary; sometimes discounted to 89), ticket said to include sightseeing bus; a visitor says bus 15 CNY extra, so inclusion is unverified. Needs advance reservation per Ctrip, but not recorded as needs=booking since unconfirmed officially. Ctrip notes seasonal free-ticket announcements ('free off-season before April') of unknown currency. Wikipedia: part of China Danxia WHS 2010, AAAAA scenic area; Jiangshan, Shimen town.

taizhou-3.bio: Hillside park in Huangyan with nine small peaks, old wells and pagodas, plum-stump gardens and walking paths.
taizhou-3.ticket_note: Municipal park; no official site found.
taizhou-3.notes: COORDINATES WRONG: supplied point 27.3728, 112.3234 is in Hunan, not Taizhou. The Taizhou 'Jiufeng' is Jiufeng Park (九峰公园, 4A), 243 Jiufeng Rd, Huangyan District, Taizhou, 1.5 km from Huangyan centre; pin must be re-resolved by the orchestrator. Free per Ctrip ('free, no ticket') and reviewers; weak source. Name may be better 'Jiufeng Park'. Gate hours exist so costBasis 'open' is arguable; 'entry' with free=true is the alternative.
